title: Small profinite parameter site, internal actions and trivial coefficients
statement: Use the compatible universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $P$ be the category of profinite sets in universe $u$ with finite jointly surjective covers, and let $R$ be any commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Write $B=\operatorname{AsSmall}_{u+1}(P)$, with $\operatorname{par}:B\to P$ the canonical equivalence. A presieve $W$ on $S$ is in $J_B(S)$ precisely when its set of arrows is finite and for each $s\in\operatorname{par}(S)$ there exist an arrow $f:T\to S$ in $W$ and $t\in\operatorname{par}(T)$ with $f(t)=s$. For a topological group $G$ in universe $u$, define $K_G(S)=\operatorname{ULift}_{u+1}C(\operatorname{par}(S),G)$ with pointwise multiplication and restriction by precomposition. These formulas give the finite-cover site and group sheaf on it. Define $\operatorname{Actions}_G$ to be the category of internal $K_G$-actions [lem-sfb-action-topos-geometric-restriction]. Precomposition by $\operatorname{par}^{op}$ identifies sheaves on $P$ with sheaves on $(B,J_B)$. Let $r$ be the sheaf of commutative section rings of $R$. Its underlying set sheaf on $B$ is $S\mapsto r(\operatorname{par}(S))$. Define the trivial coefficient action to be this sheaf with every local section of $K_G$ acting as the identity. No action-space presentation equivalence is part of these definitions.
